translations.web: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
translations.bsb: Many plans are in a man’s heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
translations.kjv: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
translations.asv: There are many devices in a man's heart; But the counsel of Jehovah, that shall stand.
